description: This file contains unit tests for decoding various types of GatewayFrame messages, including event frames, request frames with nested parameters, and unknown frames with raw data. It validates decoding logic and payload structure within the openclaw project.

methods.name: `decodes event frame with any codable payload`
methods.description: Tests decoding of an event frame with a payload containing a 'presence' event, verifying payload contents and sequence number.

methods.name: `decodes request frame with nested params`
methods.description: Tests decoding of a request frame with nested parameters, validating various payload details including nested objects and arrays.

methods.name: `decodes unknown frame and preserves raw`
methods.description: Tests decoding of an unrecognized frame type, ensuring raw data is preserved correctly.
